# @stackline/sse v{{VERSION}}

`@stackline/sse` provides the complete Server-Sent Events lifecycle in one
package with no runtime dependencies.

## Main exports

- `createParser`: incremental WHATWG SSE parser for strings and UTF-8 bytes.
- `decodeSSE`: pull-based async iterator over Response, Web Stream or iterable.
- `decodeJSON`: JSON event decoding with optional `[DONE]` sentinel.
- `encodeSSE`, `encodeJSON`, `encodeComment`: injection-safe encoding.
- `fetchSSE`: streaming fetch with retries, resume IDs, timeouts and abort.
- `fetchEventSource`: callback-oriented migration surface.
- `eventStreamResponse`: Response from synchronous or asynchronous events.
- `createSSEChannel`: push channel with backpressure and optional heartbeat.

## Defaults

- Maximum line length: 1 MiB.
- Maximum accumulated event size: 1 MiB.
- Maximum queued events per feed slice: 4,096.
- Internal feed slice: 16 KiB.
- Retry: unlimited, matching native EventSource behavior. Production callers
  should set a finite budget, total timeout or AbortSignal.

## Compatibility

ESM, CommonJS and browser global builds are published. Declarations are tested
with TypeScript 3.9 through 7. Parser and encoder work on Node.js 14.17 and
newer; inject fetch or Web Stream globals where an older runtime lacks them.

## Canonical resources

- https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/sse/
- https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/sse/reference.md
- https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-sse
